lines.en: : Hey, have any of you guys seen Kirin? Noriko’s been looking for her. And also, have any of you seen Noriko? Otoha’s been looking for her.
: Hey, have any of you guys seen Maya? I wrapped up everything that was left over from the catering order and I don’t know who else to give it to.
: I have not seen anyone in twelve hours. But perhaps Zagull Throat Spear to my left is able to be of assistance.
: Molly MacCormack reporting in as Zagull Throat Spear has also left the party. And no, I’ve not seen any of them in hours.
: Rin’s missing as well and won’t pick up her phone. I think the shape-shifting seductress may have finally gotten to her, though.
: Assuming that means Chika, she’s gone as well, so that would make sense.
: The hell’s going on with the party this year? Y’all are dropping like flies. We started with basically a full house and now I can count everybody left on two hands.
: Or at least I’d be able to under normal circumstances. You ever wear mittens before? These things suck. I’m swapping back to the Malloween team after this year.
: Do you think it has something to do with the lack of an overlord, Miss Imai?
: Sure. Definitely. What?
: “Overlord” as in Sir. His immediate abandonment of the Christmalloween quest may have bugged out some of the NPCs here. The only ones who still remain are those romantically irrelevant.
: Damn, MacCormack! I’m right here! The hell, yo?!
: N-Not including yourself, obviously! You are, by all accounts, the most logical and politically correct heroine I know. It’s just that...well...
: People in games don’t tend to make the most politically correct choices all that often. So perhaps-
: Stop talking, Emerald Guardian. Even blind, I can see that you are only making things worse.
: I’m just gonna take all the sexual tension between Chika and Rin as a sign that you’re talking about romantic relevancy among each other.
: But that would contradict the first half of the Emerald Guardian’s statement where she directly tied the Supreme Overlord to said relevancy.
: Cool, Tsuneyo. Thanks. I really wanted to be reminded of that again. That makes me look like a great semi-permanent chaperone for you girls.
: A-All I am saying is that there is a clear difference between this party and those from the days of yore! And the lack of a male authority figure is the most striking difference I can think of.
: Then, am I just not as fun as him or something? Because he ain’t really fun at all and that’ll be a major blow to my self-esteem.
: You guys were the same way when I did Dorm Wars without him. I just can’t keep anybody interested without some hulking hot guy hanging around and okay I get it now.
: Speaking from experience, there are plenty of girls in the class who find you just as attractive if not more than Sir, Miss Imai.
: Thank you, Molly. Not sure how I feel about the subtle pickup line, though.
: I’m sorry. I’m grinding affection with everyone right now since my route is destined to remain incomplete when all is said and done with this world.
: I will be lucky if I receive one at all.
: What does a beautiful woman have to do to get a good dicking nowadays?
: Molly.
: I swear I didn’t teach her that.
: Tsuneyo.
: Sup, bro?
: I don’t like the amount of sexual confidence that eyemask is giving you.
: If you were me, you would be confident as well. This is not something I should get in trouble for.
: Yeah, you ain’t wrong. Your genes are so damn strong that Sydney Sweeney’s gonna be advertising you next.
: And you know, honestly? Probably a good PR move for her given the circumstances.
: I hope I, too, can grow breasts one day. That would be nice.
: Keep dreaming, Molly. They ain’t gettin’ much bigger.
: So, I’ve been thinkin’ about boobs lately.
: Have you tried stopping?
: Yeah, but they just keep poppin’ up, so tryin’ to stop it seems useless.
: Thing is, though, I think I’m turnin’ a new leaf, Io. Finally bein’ proud of my body and stuff like that.
: Like, ain’t it easier shoppin’ for clothes when we don’t gotta worry ‘bout  how much cleavage we’re gonna be showin’ the world?
: Plus, some floppy dohankobandolangos wouldn’t do nothin’ but slow me down on land and in-
: Miku, this is quiet room. Not the dohankobandolangos room. Please cease your dohankobandolango talk and address me like the asexual misogynist I am. Thank you.
: Is that the word for you not wantin’ Sensei to shove his wiener down there? Misogynist?
: Misogynist means I don’t like females. Asexual means I don’t like sex.
: Me and Uta are females and you like us.
: There are exceptions to every rule. You and Uta are clearly that.
: So, you gonna make exceptions to the whole wiener thing too? Cause Sensei really likes shovin’ his wiener in places. Which’d be totally fine if it wasn’t for all the blood.
: God, I hope Uta shows up soon.
: Yeah, well, you’re in luck.
: My quest for love has once again failed and I remain just as Sensei-starved as always.
: I almost got gay with Ami again, though. So at least there’s that.
: Almost? You’ve gotta follow through on that stuff, Uta. You don’t want to wind up as a sexual like Io.
: A-sexual. Also, please stay away from her, Uta. I don’t want her to mail me your head in a box one day for getting too close to her uncle.
: I don’t know, Io. At this point, she might be the only chance I ever have at love. But apparently, blue-balling me runs in her family, so...
: How are things in here? Where’d Yasuyasu go?
: Said some stuff about my cooter and left. I’m sure hers ain’t much looser, though. Specially if she ain’t ever played with it like she said in class that one time.
: I have so many questions.
: She forgot to take her medication and stepped out to go do that. She hasn’t come back since, though. Figured she just went to the other room.
: What? Io! You should’ve gone to check on her! Touka trusted me with taking care of her tonight since she had to go do rich girl stuff!
: Then shouldn’t you have been doing that instead of going on a quest for penis?
: You won’t get it as a sexual, Io, but this ain’t any penis we’re talkin’ about. This is like the granddaddy of dick.
: I know. I’ve seen it plenty of times. I’m just too much of a sexual to care, I guess.
: When do I get a turn?! The only time I’ve ever seen it up close, I fainted and wound up in Io’s bed! That’s not the ending I want! Unless Io is okay with it! Which she’s not, so neither am I!
: You’re even shorter than me, Uta. How do you know your cooter ain’t gonna split in half too?
: Willpower and hormones. The only things a girl needs.
: Okay, I’m just renting out my own quiet room next time. I’m tired of hearing about genitals.
: So! How was the union of your respective genitals? Get it all out of your system, you two? Do I get a turn now?
: Uhh-
: Wonderful. There is so much of your father’s cum inside of me right now that it is going to usurp my birth control and expand your family. You are welcome.
: Really?
: She needed to know.
: I don’t think she did...
: Well, I’m glad you guys had fun. The party was kind of lame this year, all things considered. People kept leaving.
: But I guess the bright side is that I got to hog the karaoke box all night because of it. I even sang Despacito in honor of Ayane. Horribly, of course. But hey, I did my best.
: Did she not come back?
: No — was she supposed to? I assumed you just pounded her into oblivion too after you guys walked out together and that she needed to go home to recover. Sounds nice.
: That would be me if I was not the most experienced dad-fucker here. Which I am.
: She-
: So much cum.
: She-
: So much.
: Just ignore her. It’s only post-coital elation.
: Cum...
: It should’ve been me.
: Ami, have you heard anything from Ayane? Even a text? Because she left pretty urgently and-
: And you haven’t checked on her? Why? What were you doing? Besides Maya, I mean.
: Cum...
: Okay, Maya. Maybe you should go for a walk.
: So much cum. So much.
: Before her...it was Nodoka. But that was...
: That was what, Dad? You can tell me anything and I’ll only get a little horny.
: Or maybe a lot depending on what you guys did. I’m sort of leaning into you fucking all my friends now. You think it’s some sort of defense mechanism? It probably is. I’m so silly and cute.
: Ami, something happened with Ayane and me, but neither of us can remember what. And now, we’re both in a lot of pain and...
: Dealing with that the only ways we really know how to.
: So she’s in her room crying while you’re emptying yourself out inside a bunch of high schoolers. Got it.
: I was just...hoping that maybe it would only be temporary for her. That she’d be fine in a few hours.
: Well...was it temporary for you, Dad? Do you feel better now that you’ve sufficiently coped?
In a sense...yeah.
I kind of do.
And I don’t know if that has something to do with me just being high on finally getting to have sentient sex with Maya, but it’s almost like I’m suddenly numb to everything I was feeling before.
That creates a new sensation, though. One of guilt, I think. Where I believe there’s something I should be upset about, but I can’t remember what and now I have to blame myself for it.
: Your face says it all. You don’t even have to answer.
: So instead, I’ll congratulate you. On finally getting back to normal.
: Normal?
: With Maya, of course.
: Honestly, all that “will they/won’t they” stuff about getting back together had gotten so annoying over the last couple of years that even I was like, “oh my god, just do it already.”
: Not enough to stop getting in the way whenever I could, though. My Daddy’s at his best when he’s pumping his little girl full of hot father juice.
: Not enough to stop getting in the way whenever I could, though. My Daddy’s at his best when he’s forced to go long periods of time without sexual relief.
: Just like his poor daughter that he condemned to a life of infinite masturbation while she does his laundry!
: You knew?...
: About us?
: Do you think there’s anything I don’t know about you?
: Because that’s specifically how I’m able to take such good care of you, Dad.
: Everything I do is to make you happy. And you should never question any decision I make because I am always right. Okay?
: No, Ami...you’re not always right. You weren’t right when you pushed Niki out of the house. You weren’t right when you decided to stab me.
: That-
: That was an accident...And I’m still really sorry for it.
: I get scared sometimes. I’m still just a teenager, you know. But I try to be strong and, even when you hide things from me for as long as you hid Maya, I put on a brave face for you.
: Are you hiding anything from me, Ami?
: You really think I’d do that, Daddy?...
: I’d need to have a pretty good reason for it if I did, huh?
: Did you and Ayane actually have a talk earlier?
: I don’t remember. We have talks all the time. Which one are you talking about?
: The one about what’s happened to this place.
: I don’t remember. We have talks all the time. Which one are you talking about?
: Dad?
: You’re faking that, aren’t you?
: Faking what? What do you mean?
: I don’t remember. We have talks all the time.
: I’m just trying to figure out what you’re talking about here. What’s so hard to understand about that?
: Ami...if you know more than you’re letting on...I need you to tell me.
: Well, again, I have no idea what you’re talking about. But let me just say this-
: If there was a car speeding down the road with a driver passed out behind the wheel and you were right there in its way-
: I’d become my mother for you.
: Ami-
: I’ll become her without that, though. So you can finally know how it feels to be loved again.
: Now, ask yourself — how could a girl that caring ever want to hurt you?
: Merry Christmas, Dad.
: Do yourself a favor and check on Ayane, will you? She’s probably going through it right now.
: ...Yeah.
: Yeah, I’ll...
: I’ll go check on her...
A hundred days go by in the literal blink of an eye.
Do you think you can get out?
I think you should try.
